name: Zucchini, Red Pepper & Sun-Dried Tomato Frittata with Dressed Arugula
ingredients: 1 (12 oz) jar roasted red bell peppers
instructions: Wash, dry, trim and medium dice zucchini. Place in a medium bowl.
Preheat a large ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add zucchini and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 4-5 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
Meanwhile, place eggs, pesto, salt, and pepper in the reserved bowl; whisk to combine.
Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.

When the zucchini is done, reduce heat to medium-low; pour the egg mixture into the skillet. As eggs set around the edge of the skillet, gently lift cooked portions with a spatula to allow uncooked egg to flow underneath. Cook until bottom and sides are firm but top is still runny, about 5 minutes.
While the egg is cooking, drain and roughly chop roasted peppers.
Sprinkle peppers and cheese over the frittata. Place skillet in the oven and broil until top is set and cheese is melted, 3-4 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry arugula (skip this step if it came pre-washed).
To serve, cut frittata into wedges and divide between plates. Add arugula to the plate and drizzle with dressing. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
